name: [MYTHICAL] Garden Horizons 🌱
desc:
🌻 Grow, harvest, and build the garden you want.

🌱 Start with a plot of dirt and a handful of seeds. Plant crops, tend your garden, and watch things grow - but pay attention. Weather changes, mutations happen, and no two farms end up the same!

🔧 Unlock new gear, expand your flora diary, and climb the leaderboards. There's always something to work towards.
